en: This is great, I ain't been around this many people since forever! A few of 'em have given me funny looks because of... well you know why. Nobody's given me any real grief though, and that's something.  Anyway, was there something you needed, or you just come by to fraternize? I'm good either way.
Good to see you.
Naw, I didn't think so. You'd miss me anyway.
Dammit, you're strong.
Hey, screw you, I need that!
What a day this is turning out to be, eh? Guess we're partners now!
I really appreciate your help, and I appreciate your taking the time to have an earnest discussion with me. You're a good sort of person, the sort of person this island could use more of.
Thanks again. I'm gonna double-check my supplies and my route before heading out.
Hmm. You know it's not a terrible idea. Based on what we talked about, you'd probably be a safer bet than the people I was going to look for anyhow.
Well it's a nice idea, but yeah, probably not good to change plans on something like that so suddenly. Take care.

When we got on that damn lift, I admit I did not see this coming. 

I was heading off to find a commune of other lycanthropes at a place called Hayill. 

I'd heard it was a halfway decent place to live, where nobody gives you flak for letting it hang out. 

And you know, maybe I'll still go there when all this is done, but for now I think I'm content to stay on. 

You got a way of bringing people together. You know it, and we all do too. 

Whatever you do, it's gonna be big, and I wanna be there to see it. 

|I... erm... well I made you something, last time I had a day off. 

It ain't worth much maybe, but I wanted to do something to say thank you. 

I put it in the stash, so take a look when you get a chance. 

And... thanks again.
I love living like this. Struggling for survival might be difficult, but it's.. "real", you know? There's nothing pretentious or complicated about it. Definitely something a guy could get used to.
Aww, don't say that to me now! Am I really that bad?
I see. I guess I should've known better than to get comfortable.
See anything you want? You got the coin, and it's all yours.
Got some stuff for sale here!
Alright then. See you next time, if there is a next time.
Line up for the reaping!
You fools know not who you oppose.
There, Master.
I see something.
Impressive.
That may be a setback.
I see nothing.
Nothing of note.
Formidable indeed. Most interesting.
Destroy me if you can!
The master is not yet finished with you.
You do not have permission to die.
You are a coward and a fool.
Spare me your sniveling.
We do not need that one, Master.
Worthless pawn.

I am here to serve in any capacity you require of me. I will be your bodyguard and your advisor at the bare minimum. I will also defend any... fodder you acquire along the way. Your possessions and your pawns are also my charge. The contract you have forged will be honoured.
Though you are free to release me from the contract, you do understand that releasing me will not negate your obligation.
Yes, Master?
I thought not. Why throw away a lifetime of service when you have already paid for the privelege?
Then you are more the fool. I will, as they say, see you in hell, Maledicus.

You are making excellent progress, Master.

Whatever seed you sow upon this island, the weight of your actions shall undoubtedly be felt for ages yet to come."

Zantanak sits down and gazes into the fire. His face seems, for a moment, almost human.

"It has been long since I planted my feet upon the soil of the mortal world. I had forgotten how... intoxicating it can be. 

Perhaps I've more acquired a taste for it over the centuries. 

|The strangest thing I find is that I am mimicking human mannerisms more often. 

I heard the others talking about me, as they often do. They oft whisper their fear of me to one another, but this time, they were laughing, saying that I was finally learning how to blend in. 

Perhaps they were right. 

In any case, it will be easier to command an army of fools who feel more at ease than ones who feel less so. 

I encouraged it, and will continue to do so."

|Zantanak wrinkles his nose and stands up. 

"I am even imitating the troublesome human tendancy to run my mouth for no useful reason, it seems.

The real reason I came to see you was to inform you that I have been granted additional power to serve you.

I have bound it within a fetish and left it among your possessions.

This place is not properly suitable as a base of operations, but there is precious little to choose from here. I would recommend that we find someplace imposing, a veritable fortress from which we may strike terror into the hearts of your foes. If it is your pleasure, of course.
If you terminate my contract now, your end must still be upheld. You understand this?
Whatever you need, Master.
You had best take full advantage of my service while it is still available to you.
Then farewell, Maledicus. I will see you again, far sooner than you may like.

...well, despite his recklessness, he is a dear friend of mine. We were pastors in a village church, back home.
I fear for his safety, though. He has lost his way in recent months.

Forgive me, I've kept you for long enough, and I must keep looking elsewhere.
Blessings upon you, and a safe journey, wherever it is you're heading.

He wears a set of robes similar to mine.
Does the emblem on my mantle look familiar at all?

Oh! Excuse me, but have you seen a man named Evans
on your travels? He's...
Well, I suppose it is unlikely that you would have come across him. He could be anywhere by now.

You have seen the magic circle inside that old
run-down cottage, haven't you? It's a design he often used, so I'm sure he's been here, but it seems the trail is somewhat cold.
Butchered six cows today. Would take on more work, but teaching my eldest boys to do it slows me down.

I can't even teach my boys to be good fighters, since my pa never bothered to teach me. I saved up all that money so I could send my boys to any academy they wanted, and Kam wants to go to military school. His brothers will probably all follow him. Even my boys don't need me.
I hate stupid girls
I was so happy when our second daughter was born, but my husband became depressed. He thinks that I won't have any more children with him now that we've had two girls.
I'm just a useless orc now.

Or, maybe it's just me slowing down. Now that we've got two girls, my wife gets a generous stipend from the county every month. It's far more money than I ever make in a month, so my work no longer makes a difference. She doesn't need me anymore.
That fool man. Doesn't he know by now how much I love him and our army of little boys? I'll have as many children as he'll bless me with. I couldn't be happier.
Everyone else wait outside. This is going to be messy.
Finally alone. Anything you want to say before we get started?
I hope you're ready for this.
I know they're all out there waiting for us but I don't even care. I've waited more than twenty years for this moment. They can wait another hour.
I've been wanting to tear your clothes off with my teeth ever since we got finished with Frico and your heart started beating again. I'm done waiting.
No, it can't.
That's it, I can't take this anymore.
Ugh, fine. Just get it out of your system so you can focus for once.
Uh oh. What is it now?
Wait, what? Right now? Can't it wait until later?
Yeah. Ever since you cured me, and all the feelings came rushing back, I've been lookin' forward to this.

Arpa, our newest line, offers service to the southern ports of the Coldforge region as well as the breathtaking north shore of the Blackglass mountains, where many of our island's world-famous natural springs attract throngs of visitors annually.
Food! Food! Bring me everything you've got!

In fact, with regular use, the inside of the tunnels remain smooth, straight, and clean, and the only maintenance the culture requires is on either end of the tunnel, in order to prevent it from growing too far into the outside environment.

In order to keep the culture moist and alive, enclosed conditions were necessary, so the transit system was established fully  underground where the culture is able to regulate its own environmental needs.
Planning a trip with the Royal Transit System has never been easier. Fast, comfortable, and affordable, offering access to all major destinations in Lukatt!
Remember that all tickets include complimentary refreshments and an in-transit meal. For dining car hours, please ask your concierge.
Royal Transit System
So, the next time you travel, put your feet up and travel with us, your friendly Royal Transit System. See you soon!

The Arkasin line offers service to the midland destinations in the Knightwood area as well as to the scenic Pagewood, with close access to shipping ports bound for Tsarath and a ready sampling of coastal life.

The Klarthus line was established for easy connections to the historic Yaksteppe area, where our island's traditions began many years ago, and the popular Forfshire region, where the scenic beaches attract thousands every year.
The Royal Transit System was established under the enlightened rule of King Naczer II. Court researchers experimented with culturing the remarkable phenomenon commonly called Primordial Ooze.

The Zias line is the longest of our transit lines, clocking in at just over eight hours, and it offers service to both the popular markets of Whetners, and the Knavewood region, where many of our greatest artisans practice their crafts.
The Zosark line is currently under construction, and promises to expand our transit network even further, putting the whole of our beautiful island easily within your reach.
The extraordinary properties of this ooze also prompt it to grow its own support structures in the form of ribs, so the tunnel actively prevents its own collapse.
The length of the Arpa line is approximately six and one-half hours, so find a seat and make yourself comfortable! For our Gold Seal ticket holders, your private cabins are waiting!

The ooze was known to cover large continuous surfaces if left undisturbed, and has no stomach, but a powerful muscular swallowing mechanism in order to spread food across as much of its surface as possible.
The original line, Chrun, offers service to the King's Caldera for an exciting day in the big city, and Bracewind to relax in the peace and natural beauty of our island's southernmost destination.

Welcome to the Arpa line of the Royal Transit System. We're here to ensure that your journey is as comfortable and relaxing as possible, so please ask one of our friendly staff members if you need anything or have any questions.
When applied to the inside of a tunnel and appropriately stimulated by scent and tactile cues, the large culture 'swallows' in a particular direction, providing labour-free movement to the trains.
Whew. I couldn't eat another bite!

... well this is not what I was expecting, but it's certainly diverting, I'll give you that. I feel like I shouldn't be reading it with you standing here, however, so I'll just hold on to that for later. Thank you, I think. Let me give you a little something for it.
? I've never heard of this book. Let's see...
Anyway, if you do find your way into that room, let me know what you find. You can have it of course, but I am terribly curious.

I'm Vankan, by the way. I'll just hang out here, if you don't mind. This place is the best shelter I've found so far, and there are enough books to keep me reading for the rest of my life. And, who knows? Maybe I'll discover something truly amazing!
It's a shame all of these books are historical. As much as I love plumbing the depths of history, it would be nice to read something frivolous for a change.

Korolf flexed his rough hewn abs and Milde found herself being guided to her soft bed by the sheer force of Korolf's undulating midsection. She parted her thighs in anticipation, exposing the soft, green petals of her... oh.

Looters? Not much valuable here, unless you're looking for history. Found some particularly interesting material regarding the fall of the old kingdom. I've already read it all, of course. Take a look, and don't mind me. I sleep here but I make no real claim to the building.
Oh, if you have your heart set on looting, there is that locked room over there, I suppose. I haven't found a key, so I have no idea what's inside. If you think you can get in, go ahead.
Probably not though.
The Burntfoot March
The Sumptuous Garden
What have you got there, now?
Afterward, I will quit this estate for good, and start my new life with my beloved by my side.

Carrots,
Parsnips.
Cellar

Crimson Peony,
Dwarf Rhododendron,
Royal Amethyst.
I know who is behind it. He has always wanted her for himself, and he is the only one in this estate with enough skill to unravel my enchantment without destroying it outright.
I want revenge, but now is not the time. Instead, I will focus on creating a new gem for my sweetheart. One even better than before--one more becoming of her sweetness and innocence.

It feels rather soon, but I have decided I shall propose to her on the night of the Summer festival. We have both subtly confessed our feelings for each other, so time is of the essence. I must find a nice suit, and practice what I shall say to her.
Pantry

Spring Greens,
Kale,
Cauliflower.
Summer Festival
Sweet Potatoes.

This time, however, I shall take precautions. Tonight, after everyone is asleep, I will sneak outside through the cellar and hide the gem in the old well. If I used the back door, they would hear the wretched thing groaning for certain.

Today is the last weekend before the Summer festival. I've checked on the new gem nearly every night since I hid it, and nobody seems to suspect anything. Now, I can finally focus my efforts on the revenge I have been waiting for so patiently. He will learn to regret crossing me.

Today, I discovered that someone has tampered with the engagement ruby I had toiled over these past months. The clear, brilliant, pinkish-red shimmer it once had is gone. It is now filled with cracks, and has turned a dull, cloudy red. I feel sick and angry just looking at it.

Today, I have finally succeeded in creating an engagement present for my beloved. An enchanted red ruby, transmuted from a mere chunk of glass. Whenever I hold it, it instills a feeling of warmth and comfort. I hope that she will keep it close to her, and think of me.

Today, I have finished a new gem to give to my sweetheart. A simple, pure white crystal. It shines with a calming blue glow. I confess I could have used this myself when I discovered that blackguard's tampering.
Until the eve before the Summer festival, the gem shall lay hidden beneath the grounds of this estate, out of anyone else's reach. I will keep the cellar key hidden in the spare room until then.

A woman who rages against the unfairness of the whole world. What's one more beast to her? Her rage will serve you well, but she is dangerous in more ways than that. She understands nothing, and will be the doom of her entire people. Let her bring doom elsewhere.

Ah, tatters and skin, it's a timeless look, and I do like my would-be heroes wearing as little as possible. That one's fun, but I'm not certain he really has the ferocity you're going to need here. I'd say that you must know something here I don't, but frankly that's not possible.

Ah, your loyal servant, of course. He hates your guts, you know. Good thing he's cosmically bound by contract and all that. He'll be useful fodder in the fight at least. Still, it would've been better if you had summoned me instead. I at least know how to have fun.
All my life I have prepared for this moment. You, divine beast, have a place waiting on the edge of my blade!

And what would an epic final confrontation be without a manipulative, heartless sorcerer? There's a man who feels nothing but cold fascination, who pays more attention to the patterns of his killing magic than to the screams that follow it. He'll probably be useful.
Are you also fond of

Are you really certain that bringing the batty old doomsayer to face down a literal and actual divine beast is a good idea? He seems as liable to kneel and worship as to fight. Then again, once you've seen him, maybe you'll want to kneel and worship too. It's been known to happen.

Are you serious? That one may be eager to prove himself to you but at heart, he is a worker, not a warrior. Are you quite certain it is a good idea to let him use this particular crucial moment as an opportunity to build on his broken self-esteem?
Are you surprised to see me? This place is further removed from the rules of your world than most, so I can briefly manifest enough to make my voice heard. To you, anyway.
At least I'll have a grand grave. To die in the tomb of King Chevre is no small thing. Better still to be buried with my brothers, though.

Does that one even know what he wants? Do you think so indecisive a creature could give you a decisive edge in a war against a holy engine of fury? I can only guess at the leaps of your mind to think that this was a sound tactical decision, and I am frankly finding doubt at your odds of success.
Excellent. The chains hold strong, and slaying him should be simple. Once he lies dead, you will be free to leave the island by sea. Let us be done with it.

For as long as you remain on this island and work toward building a kingdom, you will have serendipitous fortune and health, as will your successors. Five-hundred years' worth, as promised, and then the crown is mine. Let's get started, shall we?
For five hundred years, you and your kin shall know my protection, and I shall heed your voice when I am called. This I do willingly, and then, I shall depart for places darker.
For now, though, I must rest a fortnight's slumber at least. Please, go, and carry with you my thanks. I will see you soon.

Fresh-faced youth is likely to end up dashed upon the floor in a place like this. He's enthusiastic and grows a decent enough beard, but one way or another, this place will probably scar him for life. Don't be surprised if he's useless afterwards, even if he survives.
He's incredible. I wish we didn't have to fight him, but, such is our lot, and I will not hold back. I shall crash the moon into the ocean and see which of us holds!

Hear my warning. Do not try to reason with Leviathan. I am married into the royal family and he would heed me not. He is no creature of reason, but one of passion and godly rage, and he is himself the source of much of our island's suffering.

Here's one with a special hatred for The Sunken Lord! Oh, I can just smell the lust for revenge leaking out his pores! I wonder what he would offer me in exchange for my dark blessing? A portion of that lust for myself, perhaps? No matter. Ensure he does not kill Leviathan. I need him alive.
I am Maxim Spartill, Lord Consort of Her Royal Highness Queen Glamig Cosova of Lukatt, and I am slain.
